product_one_liner.value: SpotDraft is an AI-powered contract lifecycle management platform that helps in-house legal and business teams draft, review, approve, sign, store and manage contracts.

pricing_page.notes: Public pricing page describes contract-volume-based plans and included services; numerical prices are not published.

employee_band.notes: Crunchbase reports 251–500 employees, which falls within the requested 201–500 band.

eng_blog.notes: Engineer Anirudh Varma authored technical posts explaining SpotDraft’s Angular implementation and frontend migration to an Nx monorepo.

public_docs.notes: Public help articles document developer settings, API credentials, webhooks and API-based team assignments.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Live opening: Product Manager - AI @ SpotDraft; this is an AI product role, not a data-scientist position.

model_provider.notes: The AI LLM subprocessor section lists all three for metadata extraction, contract questions and guideline-based contract review.

compliance_certs.notes: The company lists ISO 27001 certified and SOC 2 Type I & II, plus HIPAA and GDPR compliance; HIPAA and GDPR are compliance claims, not standalone certifications. PCI DSS certification was not established.

last_funding.notes: Strategic investment from Qualcomm Ventures, announced January 27, 2026.

raised_18mo.notes: The January 2026 investment falls within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Live opening: Account Executive- US @ SpotDraft.

launched_6mo.notes: On October 29, 2026, SpotDraft announced availability in the Claude connector directory, enabling contract-library search and analysis from Claude.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: On December 3, 2025, SpotDraft announced Alon Waks as Chief Marketing Officer and Amit Sharma as Chief Financial Officer, describing them as strategic hires.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The subprocessor list identifies HubSpot as hosting prospect information and Coefficient as syncing HubSpot CRM data to Google Sheets. Salesforce is a documented product integration; this does not establish internal Salesforce use.
